caption:
साउथ सिनेमा के सुपरस्टार धनुष ने Box Office पर एक नया और बड़ा इतिहास रच दिया है! 🔥

post-COVID दौर में धनुष की फिल्मों का worldwide collection 1000 करोड़ के पार पहुंच गया है। उनकी हालिया फिल्म OM ने शुरुआती 4 days में 91.62 करोड़ की कमाई की, जिससे post-COVID में उनकी 10 theatrical releases का कुल global collection बढ़कर 1021.76 करोड़ हो गया है।

इस शानदार उपलब्धि के साथ धनुष अब Rajinikanth, Thalapathy Vijay, Suriya और Chiyaan Vikram के बाद 1000 करोड़ का आंकड़ा पार करने वाले Kollywood के 5th male star बन चुके हैं! 💥

उनकी फिल्मों की बात करें तो 164 करोड़ कमाने वाली Tere Ishk Mein धनुष की अब तक की सबसे ज्यादा कमाई करने वाली फिल्म है। हालांकि, 200 करोड़ के भारी-भरकम budget में बनी उनकी नई फिल्म OM को mixed reviews मिले हैं और रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक इसके 150 करोड़ के आंकड़े तक पहुंचने की संभावना भी कम ही नजर आ रही है। 🎬

क्या आपने धनुष की नई फिल्म OM थिएटर में देख ली है? आपको धनुष की कौन सी फिल्म सबसे ज्यादा पसंद है? हमें कमेंट्स में जरूर बताइए! 👇

ctx.title: Box Office: Dhanush Becomes Kollywood’s 5th Male Star To Gross 1000 Crore Worldwide Post-COVID!
ctx.summary:
With OM grossing 90 crore+ in 4 days, Dhanush has entered the 1000 crore club at the worldwide box office in the post-COVID era. 
 The post  Box Office: Dhanush Becomes Kollywood’s 5th Male Star To Gross 1000 Crore Worldwide Post-COVID!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Dhanush has entered the coveted club globally! With OM collecting 90 crore+ gross at the worldwide box office in 4 days, the actor’s cumulative post-COVID tally now has gone past the 1000 crore mark, which makes him the fifth male star in Kollywood to cross the 1000 crore worldwide mark post-pandemic as a main lead. Keep reading for a detailed report!
In the post-COVID era, the actor has had ten theatrical releases so far. His first release was Thiruchitrambalam, which grossed 117.88 crore . It was followed by Naane Varuvean, which earned 35.52 crore . Vaathi grossed 116.2 crore , followed by Captain Miller at 75.43 crore . Raayan did a business of 155.35 crore , while Kuberaa grossed 138.86 crore . Idli Kadai grossed 72.08 crore . Tere Ishk Mein grossed a solid 164 crore and is currently the actor’s highest-grossing film ever. His previous film, Kara, grossed 54.82 crore.
Coming to the latest release, OM, it has amassed 91.62 crore in 4 days, taking Dhanush’s cumulative total to 1021.76 crore gross globally.
Take a look at the worldwide collection of Dhanush’s post-COVID releases:
Dhanush is now in the company of four other Tamil stars who have already hit this landmark in the post-COVID era. They are Rajinikanth, Thalapathy Vijay, Suriya and Chiyaan Vikram. Before OM, his post-COVID worldwide total was 930.14 crore , which left him about 69.86 crore short of the 1000 crore mark. The film’s first four days were enough to cover that gap.
It’s an important feat for the actor, but for the film, these collections aren’t enough. Mounted on a budget of 200 crore , OM needed a strong run but considering mixed reviews, it is unlikely to even hit the 150 crore mark.
